description: Defines the Wraps class as a mockable wrapper around system and libc functions, including the WrapsImpl interface with various system call wrappers.

classes.name: WrapsImpl
classes.description: An abstract interface class providing virtual wrappers for system functions, allowing for mocking and testing.

classes.name: Wraps
classes.description: A singleton-like class providing static accessors to system functions via the WrapsImpl interface.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation instance for Wraps.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Wraps.

methods.name: system
methods.description: Executes a system command via the Wraps implementation.

methods.name: popen
methods.description: Opens a process by creating a pipe, wrapper around popen.

methods.name: pclose
methods.description: Closes a pipe opened by popen.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Wrapper for secure popen with va_list arguments.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Wrapper for secure system calls with va_list.

methods.name: readlink
methods.description: Reads the target of a symbolic link.
